system.description:
Game Over Man!. OPDQ: roll your Luck Pool. If you roll more Luck than Strange symbols, the Director gives guidance on where danger may lurk. If not, you may stumble onto something deadly or get bad advice.

Morbid (Flaw). Lose 1 Skill Die on all Fear Checks and on any Check that would make you Afraid or Terrified.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.89
